title.zh: 废止修订第4619号共和国法的第5855号共和国法，并恢复后一法律全部条文的法案
title.en: An Act Repealing Republic Act Numbered Fifty-Eight Hundred Fifty-Five Which Amended Republic Act Numbered Forty-Six Hundred Nineteen, and Reviving All the Provisions of the Latter Law
title.orig: An Act Repealing Republic Act Numbered Fifty-Eight Hundred Fifty-Five Which Amended Republic Act Numbered Forty-Six Hundred Nineteen, and Reviving All the Provisions of the Latter Law

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6545_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Republic Act Numbered Fifty-eight hundred fifty-five which amended Republic Act Numbered Forty-six hundred nineteen, entitled "An Act Granting Visayan Electric Company, Inc., a Franchise for Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the City of Dumaguete and in the Municipalities of Bacong, Dauin and Valencia, all in the Province of Oriental Negros," is hereby repealed and all the provisions of the said Republic Act Numbered Forty Six hundred nineteen are hereby revived.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, August 26, 1972.
